Variants.Content: The sudden loss of bird songs, insect sounds, and animal tracks in the wilderness may mean that a storm is approaching, a large predator is approaching, or there are people nearby. Silence itself is not a magical proof, but it is a signal worth stopping and observing; an experienced hunter will first check the wind direction and tracks rather than shout out the test.
